boundary_conditions: dc_dy(0) = cyprid_boundary_layer_thickness * contact_attachment_velocity * settlement_reduction_factor / cyprid_effective_diffusivity * c(0)

parameters.name: cyprid_boundary_layer_thickness
parameters.justification: Near-wall layer through which exploring cyprids (0.5 mm) reach the surface during idle periods; y = distance/thickness.

parameters.name: cyprid_effective_diffusivity
parameters.justification: Effective transport of swimming larvae by active swimming and ambient turbulence in port.
